description:
File one video in a folder of its tab: a find (find_id) in a long or packaging
    folder, a hook (hook_id) in a short one, with an optional note. A video already in the
    folder (the same find, another run's find of it, the same hook) returns that item with
    created false; a note given then replaces its note. Filing does not keep it. Same as
    POST /v1/folders/{folder_id}/items. Free. Errors: 404 find_not_found or
    hook_not_found, 422 kind_mismatch, 409 folder_full (2000 items).

find_id.description: a Long form or Packaging find of yours; or give hook_id
find_id.title: Find Id

folder_id.description: one of your folders (from list_folders or create_folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

hook_id.description: a Short form hook of yours; or give find_id
hook_id.title: Hook Id

name: save_to_folder
